_readme: Curated video source registry for GenArchitect. Human-editable.
IMPORTANT: RSS discovery requires the YouTube CHANNEL ID (starts with 'UC...'), NOT the @handle.
VERIFY every channel id below before the first real run — ids here are best-effort and may be wrong.
Channels with id starting 'REPLACE_ME' are skipped until you fill in a real id and set active:true.

How to find a channel id: open the channel in a browser, then either (a) View Source and search for 'channelId', or (b) use https://www.youtube.com/@handle and check the RSS link, or (c) the channel's About > Share > Copy channel ID. The RSS feed is https://www.youtube.com/feeds/videos.xml?channel_id=<id> .
Keep this list tight and high-signal — curation beats a firehose.
